follow-up time: Cross-sectional, but with additional serial sampling for some proteins
outcome: Proteins secreted by the placenta into maternal and fetal circulation
cohort: 35 healthy women with term pregnancies undergoing cesarean section
finding: The study identified 34 proteins secreted into the maternal circulation and 341 proteins secreted into the fetal circulation, with only 7 proteins common to both, suggesting distinct placental protein release profiles.
